goal: Pass each reviewer wrapper its own AI_*_CALLER in the environment the governed runner and the author-lane doctor probe spawn, and quote the wrapper's own stderr line when a doctor names no check, so healthy reviewers stop being refused as local dependency faults.
dispatcher: Owner Albert Hazan authorized resolving open non-orchestrator issues in this repository through to production
prohibited_actions: No database write, migration, function, view, role, grant, index, or timeout change.
Do not weaken any existing reviewer preflight refusal, and never report a probe that did not run as a pass.
Do not invent a caller identity the environment does not support.
assumptions: The caller variable per wrapper is the mapping already recorded in run-governed-review.mjs; this change moves it to a shared module rather than re-deriving it.
An undetectable caller is left unset for the doctor probe and for the spawn, because the governed review path already refuses up front when no caller can be determined.
The new shared module joins the global invalidator inventory because it is inside the manager's import closure.
stop_conditions: Stop if the repair requires any database object change.
Stop if the caller cannot be determined without guessing for the governed review path.
